title: Coastal Kitchen and Dune Deck
style: bright coastal contemporary architecture with limewashed walls, pale oak, sea-glass blue accents, woven details, and brushed steel
interior_program: an open kitchen and breakfast room with a detailed island, stools, cabinetry, shelves, pendant-like non-emissive fixtures, dining nook, tableware silhouettes, and a generous central circulation route
exterior_program: a timber deck leading into a dune garden with grasses, sculptural wind-pruned trees, low stone walls, lounge seating, and a distant boardwalk-like path
transition: a wide open framed sliding-door bay with a flush timber-and-stone threshold directly joining the kitchen floor and deck

title: Japanese Library and Rain Courtyard
style: quiet Japanese-modern architecture with dark timber frames, warm plaster, tatami tones, indigo upholstery, stone, and restrained joinery
interior_program: a reading library with full-height book shelving, low reading platforms, lounge chairs, side tables, pottery, a writing desk, and a clear axial passage
exterior_program: a contemplative rain courtyard with stepping zones outside the protected central path, gravel, moss-like ground cover, a stone basin, layered maples, timber screens, and a sheltered bench
transition: a fully open shoji-inspired framed portal with a level stone threshold that visually aligns the library aisle and courtyard path

title: Desert Ceramics Studio and Patio
style: Sonoran desert modernism with sand-colored rammed-earth forms, terracotta, turquoise glaze, dark steel, canvas, and sun-washed timber
interior_program: a working ceramics studio with sturdy worktables, stools, shelving full of varied vessel forms, a pottery wheel silhouette, drying racks, storage, and a clean central aisle
exterior_program: a shaded desert patio with a slatted canopy away from the centerline, clay display plinths, gravel beds, agave and columnar cactus forms, boulders, benches, and a path into the landscape
transition: a broad open steel-framed workshop doorway with a flush threshold and continuous hardscape from studio to patio

title: Bicycle Cafe and Pocket Park
style: lively urban adaptive reuse with red brick, cream tile, blackened steel, walnut, olive green upholstery, and small brass accents
interior_program: a neighborhood cafe with service counter, pastry display geometry, espresso-machine silhouette, mixed tables and chairs, bicycle wall racks outside the clear aisle, banquette seating, and ceiling detail
exterior_program: a compact streetside pocket park with brick paving, cafe tables, bike stands, planters, shade trees, benches, curb-free crossing detail, and neighboring facade fragments
transition: folded-open glazed storefront panels forming a generous level opening between the cafe aisle and park promenade

title: Nordic Dining Hall and Orchard
style: soft Nordic rural contemporary design with white-oiled timber, muted green, warm gray stone, linen colors, black metal, and precise craft details
interior_program: a double-purpose dining and gathering room with a long communal table, varied chairs, sideboard, open shelving, fireplace mass away from the opening, window seats, ceramics, and a clear central route
exterior_program: a small orchard terrace with gravel and stone paving, espalier frames, fruit trees, herb beds, a long bench, lantern-like non-emissive objects, and field-edge fencing
transition: an open timber portal with recessed glazed panels and a seamless floor-to-terrace threshold aligned with the orchard walk

title: Mediterranean Music Salon and Terrace
style: layered Mediterranean contemporary architecture with warm white stucco, travertine, walnut, dusty rose textiles, aged bronze, and deep green planting
interior_program: an intimate music salon with a stylized grand-piano silhouette outside the center route, upholstered seating, record shelving, console, acoustic wall panels, side tables, sculptural decor, and a clear passage
exterior_program: a stepped-looking but actually level central terrace with side planting beds, pergola structure clear of the route, dining furniture, olive and citrus trees, water-basin geometry, low walls, and a descending landscape view beyond
transition: a tall open arched rectangular hybrid portal with a level travertine threshold connecting the salon directly to the terrace axis
